_readme: Catalog of support series: which series run on which parent series' weekends. Seed for the support-series and session research. NOT read by the site yet. Statuses: confirmed (complete round list from a cited source), partial (some rounds verified, list incomplete), provisional (published but may change), pending (organizer has not published), unverified (candidate only, no source). Never mark confirmed without an https source. calendarSlug = the series already exists as its own top-level series in calendar.json.

entries.name: IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge

2026.rounds: 10 rounds, same venues as 2025. Mid-Ohio is the only standalone round (4h); Daytona is the other 4h race.

2027.rounds: 10 races; 8 run as companion to the WeatherTech Championship. Daytona and Mid-Ohio are the 4h races. Lime Rock (headline, Sep 23-25) replaces Laguna Seca. Season finale Road Atlanta Oct 6-9.

entries.note: Toyota GR Supra GT4 EVO2 cars race in this series (GSX class): there is no separate Supra series (fact from https://www.imsa.com/news/2026/01/18/michelin-pilot-challenge-roar-before-the-rolex-24-weekend-notebook/). Per-round weekend mapping still to extract from the schedule graphic.

entries.name: Whelen Mazda MX-5 Cup presented by Michelin

2026.rounds: 7 doubleheader events. Verified: Daytona Jan 21-23; St. Petersburg (with IndyCar) Feb 21-Mar 1 window; Mid-Ohio Jun 5-7; Indianapolis Road Course Sep 18-20; Road Atlanta Oct 1-3 (finale). Other two events not captured.

entries.note: The St. Petersburg date range looks wide in the source; verify the actual race days against mx-5cup.com. Check mx-5cup.com for the 2027 schedule.

entries.name: IMSA VP Racing SportsCar Challenge

2026.rounds: Runs on WeatherTech weekends. Verified: Daytona (season opener), Mid-Ohio, VIR. Full round list not captured.

entries.note: Classes in 2026 material: GSX and GTDX (and others). The VIR provisional schedule PDF (virnow.com) lists per-class practice and qualifying times: this kind of venue PDF is the best source for support-series sessions.
